newDescription: Drove your own car on the section's errand? Enter the odometer before and after, and we work out the compensation.
descriptionHint: What the journey was for, e.g. "Collect the sponsor package in Malmö".
dateFuture: The journey is in the future. Correct the date to the day you drove.
dateTooLate: Older than {days} days. A mileage claim must be filed within {days} days of the journey. You can apply for a waiver: finish the journey, save it as a draft and get in touch with the skattmästare, who decides whether it is accepted anyway.

route.label: Route
route.hint: Every place you stopped, in order. A town or a name is enough, e.g. "E-huset" and "Snabbgross". If you came back to where you started, write that place last as well, or the route describes only half the distance the odometer shows.

odometer.label: Odometer
odometer.hint: The total odometer, the car's lifetime reading, not the trip meter. What it read when you got into the car and when you got out. The distance is the difference.

deadlineHint: A mileage claim must be filed within {days} days of the journey.
perJourneyHint: If you drove several times, file one claim per journey.
documentPending: The expense report is drawn once the claim is saved. The journey is stated on it, and it is what follows the claim into the books.
editDescription: Correct the journey or the distribution.

blocker.noReadings: Enter the odometer both before and after the journey.
blocker.notForward: The reading after the journey must be higher than the one before. Check that the two are the right way round.
blocker.noRate: No rate per kilometre has been set for the day of the journey. Ask the treasurer.
blocker.noRoute: Enter at least two places you stopped at. The odometer shows how far the car went, not that the journey was the section's errand.

rates.title: Mileage rate
rates.description: What a kilometre is worth, and from which day. Every journey is valued at the rate in force on the day it was driven. A change here never re-values a claim already filed.
rates.rateHint: Skatteverket's standard rate is 25 kr/mil. Stored as öre per kilometre.
rates.saveFailed: The rate could not be saved
rates.removeFailed: The rate could not be removed
rates.removeDescription: Journeys already valued at it keep their amount. New journeys on those dates get whichever rate applied before.
rates.empty: No rate has been set yet. Without one, no mileage claims can be filed.
